behavior: When `KeepAlive` holds `Collapsible.Panel` after a `beforematch` reveal that its root does not follow, the activation runs the revert. It restores `hidden="until-found"`, `data-starting-style`, and the motion of the next open. Base UI under `Activity` writes `hidden="until-found"` again at the reveal and drops the other two, so its next open has no motion.
